letter: My dearest Liza, my jaan, every sunrise in Dubai reminds me of the golden glow of Ahmedabad’s mornings we share. Even the desert breeze whispers your name, and I smile thinking of our laughter echoing over spice‑laden streets. You’re my forever cutie, the heartbeat that steadies me across time zones. As we count the days since that beautiful February, I’m grateful for every moment we’ve woven together—hand in hand, heart to heart. I love you more than words can capture, today and always.
poem:
In dunes or dunes of wheat you bloom,  
Your smile outshines the desert moon.  
Across the miles our souls entwine,  
Forever yours, forever mine.
